items.html: But it is impossible for it to be so, except when Leah and Rachel stand at the back of ZA in the aspect of two Partzufim, one below the other; and then the upper one presses her feet and inserts them within the domain of the lower one, and they sit there pressed. But now, when they join and become a single Partzuf, it is impossible that the place opposite the middle third of the Tifferet of ZA should have these doubled lights, one within the other, because it is impossible for one part of the body to spread and clothe within another part of itself, unlike when they are separate bodies, as is known.
